announce.rateLimited: Too many lookups. Please wait and try again.

form.label: Tracking number
form.invalid: That does not look like a Reduium tracking number. It should look like RDM-XXXX-XXXX-X.

notFound.title: No shipment found
notFound.body1: We couldn't find a shipment with tracking number {{trackingNumber}}.
notFound.body2: Check it against your receipt or shipping confirmation. If it matches and still isn't found, contact support and we'll look into it.

invalid.title: That isn't a valid tracking number

rateLimited.title: Too many lookups
rateLimited.body_one: To protect our customers' shipments, we limit how many tracking lookups can be made in a short time. Please try again in about {{count, number}} minute.
rateLimited.body_other: To protect our customers' shipments, we limit how many tracking lookups can be made in a short time. Please try again in about {{count, number}} minutes.

error.title: We couldn't load tracking right now
error.body: Something went wrong on our side or with the connection. Your shipment isn't affected. Please try again in a moment.

intro.title: Enter a tracking number to begin
intro.body: Your tracking number starts with RDM and is printed on your receipt and shipping confirmation.

summary.testData: Test data. This is a development sample shipment, not a real delivery.

advice.DELAYED: Your shipment is running late. It is still on its way and this page will update as it moves. The delivery estimate below may change.
advice.ON_HOLD: Your shipment is paused and needs attention before it can continue. Please <support>contact support</support> and quote your tracking number.
advice.DELIVERY_ATTEMPTED: We tried to deliver but couldn't complete it. Check for a card or message from the courier, or <support>contact support</support> to arrange redelivery.

history.title: Tracking history
history.empty: No tracking updates have been recorded for this shipment yet. Updates appear here as soon as the shipment is scanned.
history.note: Oldest first. Times are shown in your time zone ({{timeZone}}).
